title: PM Fils-Aimé Announces Dialysis Cost Cut at OFATMA Hospital, Les Cayes
detail: Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé announced on August 14, 2026 that dialysis session costs at OFATMA Hospital in Les Cayes would be reduced from 15,000 to 5,000 gourdes, with further reductions planned, as part of limited government efforts to ease healthcare costs amid Haiti's economic contraction and collapsed public health infrastructure in gang-affected regions.

media.caption: PM Fils-Aimé announces dialysis cost reduction at OFATMA Hospital, Les Cayes

title: PM Fils-Aimé: Elections 'Will Take Place This Year, No Matter What' as CEP Finalizes Party List
detail: Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé declared on August 14, 2026 that "the elections will take place this year, no matter what," as Haiti's Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) approved 17 of 18 registered political groups — representing 228 parties — ahead of the December 13, 2026 presidential and legislative elections and constitutional referendum, with group registration closing that Friday at 5:00pm local time. Youth Minister Pythagore Dumas urged citizens, particularly young Haitians, to register to vote. The CEP said a delegation would visit the United States, Canada, France, Chile, and Brazil the following week to assess diaspora voting participation.

media.caption: PM Alix Didier Fils-Aimé reaffirms the 2026 election timeline as CEP finalizes the approved party list
